name: Lineup Manager
description: One clean guide from all your providers (same channels merged with failover), a report of everything left out with one-line add-back, and friends & family logins with expiry dates.
author: dispatcharr-lineup-manager contributors

fields.label: Countries to keep
fields.help_text: Provider groups and channels prefixed with any other country code (DE:, AR |, ...) are left out. Blank keeps every country.

fields.label: Lineup groups (JSON, optional)
fields.help_text: Blank uses the bundled US + UK + sports lineup. Paste your own {"groups": [...]} to change it; see the README for the format.

fields.label: ZIP code for local channels
fields.help_text: Fills the Locals group with the ABC, CBS, NBC, FOX, PBS and CW stations nearest you, found from your providers' own channel names. Blank keeps the Locals group as configured.

fields.label: National locals
fields.help_text: Adds every English-language ABC, CBS, NBC, FOX, PBS, CW, MyNetwork and independent station your providers carry, one 'Locals — <state>' group per state (channels from 100000). Handy when a game is on a network your own locals don't show.

fields.label: Read stream limits from Xtream providers
fields.help_text: Asks each Xtream provider for its connection limit and updates the account.

fields.label: Add these provider groups back
fields.help_text: One provider group name per line, copied from the 'What's left out' report. Each becomes its own guide group, numbered from 80000.

fields.label: Channel profile for members
fields.help_text: Optional. Blank gives members every channel.

fields.label: Server address members use
fields.help_text: Shown on setup cards. Use your HTTPS domain for members outside your home.

fields.label: Rebuild the lineup and check members every (hours)

actions.label: Preview lineup
actions.description: Shows what each guide group would get. Changes nothing.

actions.label: Build lineup
actions.description: Builds the guide groups from every active provider.

confirm.title: Build the lineup?
confirm.message: Channels in the lineup's own groups are replaced. Other groups are not touched.

actions.label: Find local channels
actions.description: Shows which local stations the ZIP code picks. Changes nothing.

actions.label: What's left out
actions.description: Lists provider groups not in the guide. Copy names into 'Add back'.

actions.label: Save members
actions.description: Creates new members' logins and turns off expired or removed members.

actions.label: Setup cards
actions.description: Login details to send each member.

actions.label: Export settings
actions.description: Saves lineup + members (no passwords) to the plugin's data folder.

actions.label: Run scheduled job now
actions.description: What the schedule runs: provider limits, lineup build, member check.

actions.label: Turn on schedule
actions.description: Rebuilds the lineup and checks expiries on the interval set under Schedule.
